name: baton
line: one thread that never fills up
question: What if the orchestrator never read a file, and its thread lasted as long as the work did?
body: A Claude Code mod. During a run the prime may only dispatch, ask and use its memory; a guard refuses everything else. Sub-orchestrators run each phase and hand back one line of at most 280 bytes, noted into a memory the prime can zoom into. Rulings you give stick across runs, irreversible commands from any agent wait for you, and every behavior change lands red, green, blue. Underneath is still the router prompt and its record: evidence that cites, verdicts per criterion, gates a person holds, and TEAM: github for a team.
alt: baton v7.5 — a prime that only dispatches to three sub-orchestrators, each handing back one line of at most 280 bytes into the prime's memory, while a guard refuses the prime's file reads and commands
